naming_convention.choice: hypercar-prefixed reference files plus explicit manifest reference pointers on the three hypercar rows
naming_convention.rationale: The reference-file short names `details.json` / `suspension_front.json` / `suspension_rear.json` are the f1 rows' oracles (row_id f1/*) and are never overwritten. New hypercar references therefore use hypercar-prefixed short names (reference/hypercar_<system>.json) and the three hypercar manifest rows gain an explicit `reference` pointer naming the file - the same pointer convention the manifest already uses for hypercar/wheels. The other nine staged hypercar rows keep the un-collided suffix short-name mapping (aero.json ... wheels.json), and the f1 manifest entries are not edited (their oracles remain discoverable under the unchanged suffix mapping). Surface touched: 3 new reference files + 3 hypercar manifest rows only.
